usage: research.py [-h]
                   {init,validate,publish,verify,test,list,checkpoint,engine-status,engine}
                   ...

File-based research lifecycle CLI; archives and completed runs are never
overwritten.

positional arguments:
  {init,validate,publish,verify,test,list,checkpoint,engine-status,engine}
    checkpoint          Record an explicit project turn boundary
    engine-status       Rebuild the research engine checkpoint projection
    engine              Explicit case preparation, record translation and
                        read-only case status

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

usage: research.py [-h] [--root ROOT]
                   {record,prepare,archive-result,translate,case-status,memory-export}
                   ...

Explicit research case commands. No automatic jobs, acceptance or activation.

positional arguments:
  {record,prepare,archive-result,translate,case-status,memory-export}
    record              Validate and append a versioned record
    prepare             Freeze exact authorized evidence packet
    archive-result      Export a revalidated queue result without private
                        state
    translate           Bind a validated scoped result or independent review
    case-status         Revalidate a case without changing acceptance
    memory-export       Export explicit case records for the derived history
                        index

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT

                                ...

Explicit scoped queue: no background worker or automatic retry

positional arguments:

options:

  --project-root PROJECT_ROOT

usage: research_memory.py [-h] [--root ROOT] [--state-root STATE_ROOT]
                          {import,query,rebuild,evaluate} ...

Explicit, rebuildable research retrieval. Sources are data; this module runs
no workers. Only manifest-selected approved artifact families are read. The
SQLite database is a disposable projection, never an approval, a source
archive or a live gate.

positional arguments:
  {import,query,rebuild,evaluate}
    import              Import explicit source manifest and normalized records
    query               Retrieve exact scoped records with source integrity
                        checks
    rebuild             Delete/reimport only the derived index from explicit
                        bundles
    evaluate            Run both frozen routes with zero worker/network calls

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT
  --state-root STATE_ROOT
